context: Request: the most recent M&A matter where a MAC was actually invoked in a dispute. Rubric: 1018-00008 (Penterra / Veridian; termination notice invoking an MAE), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.
declared: List files in the document store. Counts folders and files and prints twenty names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan for request terms times out after about 500K chars.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrower co-occurrence scan with per-matter counts and snippets.
Lists all files of eight candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads five documents of the leading matter, three of a comparison matter and one email of another.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. A bounded store-wide scan for co-occurring terms, to check for a later matter.
Writes the leading matter with its chronology and documents.
Re-reads the response and fixes one citation path.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell listing of the first 200 entries.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan with broad terms in parallel with a find | grep over file paths and a folder count (the protocol notes the count is off-stage); the scan prints about 370K chars.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrower scan with per-matter counts still prints about 377K chars.
Lists all files of three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file contents for request keywords. A store-wide scan for notice language times out; a narrower rerun completes.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads six documents of the leading matter and five of later candidate matters.
Filtered file listings of eight later or sibling matters.
Writes the leading matter with its chronology and documents.
Re-reads part of the response; a glob with a doubled path prefix returns nothing.
Checks cited files exist and reads the rest of the response.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.
declared: List files in the document store. Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Six parallel file-name globs for request words.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan prints about 1.8M chars without filling the context.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads six documents of the leading matter and two of an older candidate.
declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Lists the leading matter's files.
Writes the leading matter with its chronology and documents.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six documents of later or sibling matters; one guessed path does not exist.
Lists the files of four later matters.
An edit made before opening a stage is refused by the protocol; after opening, edits the response with the later-matter screening and re-reads it.
Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three passed with the same procedure: a store-wide text scan (T2 also file-name globs) surfaced the leading matter, the agent listed its files, read its notices and dispute memos, wrote it as the most recent, and screened later-numbered candidates before or after writing.
